subject: 35-year-old man in rubberized arch mantle
art_direction: 35岁男性穿圆拱橡胶披肩与全扣白衬，黑发低伏，暖黄背景里神态像认真开会。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Photograph an original 35-year-old man with slick short dark hair, a broad face, and a deadpan attentive expression. He wears a buttoned cream shirt beneath a dark rubberized mantle that forms two rounded arches over the shoulders. The material should have a soft industrial sheen, folded seams, and weight, rather than looking like armor. Raise one shoulder slightly as if adjusting the garment. Use a warm ochre studio background and broad frontal light. Keep the face natural, with no tattoos, badges, logos, or recognizable public figure features. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
